name: Modal
note: Bring your own model on GPUs
summary: Modal is a serverless compute platform where you define containers, GPUs and functions in Python code and Modal runs them, scaling to zero when idle. Teams use it to serve their own models, run batch and training jobs, and spin up isolated sandboxes for agents.
facts: Per second for GPU, CPU and memory; no charge when scaled to zero
Isolated environments, billed at non-preemptible rates
goodFor: Serving your own or fine-tuned models without managing Kubernetes
Bursty workloads that should scale to zero
watchOut: No managed per-token API; you deploy the model yourself
Cold starts and the 60s default keep-alive affect latency and cost
